question: The National Cooperation Policy, 2025, aims to make cooperatives key drivers for Viksit Bharat 2047 through _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sahkar-se-Samriddhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Cooperation Policy, 2025**, is built upon the vision of **Sahkar-se-Samriddhi**, which translates to "Prosperity through Cooperation."
 
• This policy aims to transform the cooperative sector into a pivotal driver of the Indian economy to achieve the goal of **Viksit Bharat 2047** (Developed India by **2047**).
 
• The new policy replaces the previous **National Policy on Cooperatives**, which was formulated in the year **2002**, to address the evolving needs of the **21st century**.
 
• A high-level national committee, consisting of **47 members** and chaired by former Union Minister **Shri Suresh Prabhu**, was constituted to draft this comprehensive document.
